annotations.title: Read what a workspace tracks today

description: Read the workspace's canonical tracked-item total and breakdown: one item per search in one market on one platform, hashtag or account, counted once however many groups include it, with paused items separate. This is the tracked total of searches, hashtags and accounts; summed group item counts or a page of list results overcount or undercount it. Pass includeItems for a page of items, including paused items, with platform, market, frequency, last and next collection, latest refresh outcome and Monitor report inclusion. The summary always covers the whole workspace. Use socialseal_list_tracking_groups for group organization, socialseal_list_tracking_items for filtered item records, or socialseal_get_tracking_group_completeness for one group's membership gaps. To read every item, repeat with offset=pagination.nextOffset while pagination.hasMore is true.

limit.description: Items per page when includeItems=true; defaults to 20, maximum 100.

offset.description: Zero-based item offset; defaults to 0. Use pagination.nextOffset to continue.

workspaceId.description: Reuse the authorized default or sole accessible workspace when omitted.
